description: Exports a single frame from a sequence as an image file. Supported formats (all verified against Premiere's QE exporters): png, jpg/jpeg, tiff/tif, dpx, tga/targa.

outputPath.description: The absolute path where the image file will be saved

sequenceId.description: The ID of the sequence. Defaults to the active sequence.

time.description: The time in seconds to export the frame from

name: export_frame
